events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The Iran conflict is escalating, with the US and its allies imposing sanctions and conducting military operations. This has led to a significant increase in oil prices and volatility in the market. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential for further escalation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran is expected to lead to higher oil prices, which will have a significant impact on the global economy. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good buy as it will benefit from the increased oil prices, while the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) is a good short as it will be negatively impacted by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and conflict escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or conflict de-escalates

events.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady

events.reasoning: The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady has led to a significant increase in bond yields, making the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) a good buy. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good short as it will be negatively impacted by the higher bond yields.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when bond yields stabilize or inflation decreases
